justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/JavacTokens.java`. `AccessibleScanner` is only a 2-line nested shim (lines 213-218) with a single protected constructor and no fields or additional methods; it exists solely to expose `Scanner(ScannerFactory, JavaTokenizer)`.
